title: NodeList
description: Response shape of GET /api/admin/nodes (docs/024 §5.1). One row per registered backend process; ordered by last_seen DESC so live nodes float to the top. The UI uses seconds_since to render the heartbeat-freshness dot (≤90s green / ≤600s amber / else red per docs/024 §1.2).

nodes.description: Zero or more registered nodes. Empty array is a valid response on a fresh deployment.

node_type.description: Platform classification — matches the CHECK on eidan.node_heartbeats.node_type.

status.description: Stored row state. UI may treat as offline when seconds_since exceeds a freshness threshold regardless of the stored value (docs/024 §3 — stop() does not mark offline).

last_seen.description: Timestamp of the last heartbeat UPSERT.

seconds_since.description: Server-computed (now() - last_seen) in seconds so the UI does not need to negotiate clock skew.

metadata.description: Platform fingerprint — always carries hostname / platform / python; per-platform keys (fly_app, fly_region, …) layer on top.
